hoeido.en: Fifty-three Stations of the Tōkaidō (Hōeidō edition)

entries.why: First state (1925.3498, Buckingham): the sparse dawn bridge with the procession and fish sellers. Alternate: 47850 (1943.720), the later crowded state titled 行列振出 gyōretsu furidashi.
First-state impression (1925.3499, Buckingham) with the deeper sea and sky bands; pairs with the first-state Nihonbashi. Alternate: 25551 (1925.3500), the later state titled 日之出 hinode, paler.
Gookin impression (1939.1365): clearer Fuji and richer river blue. Alternate: 25555 (1925.3501, Buckingham), toned paper.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3502, Buckingham); the teahouse hill on the right with the bay below.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3503, Buckingham); the procession crossing the bridge at lower right.
The brighter of two Buckingham impressions (1925.3505): fresher blues and greens. Alternate: 25563 (1925.3504), paler.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3506, Buckingham); the torii and bridge at lower left, the temple on the hill.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3507, Buckingham); the rounded hill with the two runners meeting below it.
The fresher of two Buckingham impressions (1925.3508): stronger sea blue under the rain. Alternate: 25580 (1925.3509), paler.
Henderson impression (1963.665): the pink and blue mountain colours intact, full margins. Alternates: 25584 (1925.3510, similar), 23745 (1937.199, muted later state).
Gookin impression (1939.1362): whiter Fuji and deeper lake. Alternate: 25585 (1925.3511, Buckingham), paler.

Warner gift (1932.170), the impression the approved concept page and the pack contract example already use; soft grey mist well preserved. Alternates: 149126 (1997.757, greener), 33891 (1939.1364), 25588 (1925.3512).
Only impression at AIC (1925.3513, Buckingham); the full moon over the river and the pilgrim with the tengu mask.

title.en: Hara: Mount Fuji in the Morning

entries.why: Wright gift (1961.156), the impression the approved concept page uses; Fuji breaks the upper border. Alternate: 25597 (1925.3514, Buckingham), cooler.

title.en: Yoshiwara: Mount Fuji on the Left

entries.why: Warner gift (1932.171), sibling of the Mishima impression; clean sky and the Fuji seen through the pines. Alternates: 25600 (1925.3516), 25599 (1925.3515).
Buckingham impression (1925.3517), the one the approved concept page uses as the night print. Alternate: 33881 (1939.1361, Gookin), darker sky.
Henderson impression (1963.666): orange sky band and deep bay. Alternate: 25616 (1925.3518), paler. The sheet is inscribed 由井; the app writes the station 由比 (same reading).
Only impression at AIC (1925.3519, Buckingham); the two sumo wrestlers carried across the ford.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3520, Buckingham); the pine spit of Miho and the harbour masts.
Henderson impression (1963.667): crisp, deeper blue and a dark green mountain. Alternate: 25628 (1925.3521), the mountain printed reddish.
The most colourful of three (1925.3523, Buckingham): pink dawn sky over the teahouse. Alternates: 25630 (1925.3522), 33879 (1939.1360, Gookin, trimmed).
Henderson impression (1963.668): deeper sky and gorge greens. Alternate: 25635 (1925.3524), noticeably faded.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3525, Buckingham); the relay yard with porters and packhorses.

title.en: Shimada: The Suruga Bank of the Oi River

entries.why: Only impression at AIC (1925.3526, Buckingham); the crossing seen from above on the Suruga bank. The sheet is inscribed 嶋田; the app writes 島田 (same reading).

title.en: Kanaya: The Far Bank of the Oi River

entries.why: Gookin impression (1939.1359): blue mountain shading intact, no fold. Alternate: 25657 (1925.3527), a visible centre fold.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3528, Buckingham); travellers around the night-weeping stone on the pass.

title.en: Kakegawa: Distant View of Mount Akiba

entries.why: Only impression at AIC (1925.3529, Buckingham); the bridge, the kite and Mount Akiba.
Buckingham impression (1925.3530): pink horizon and full margins. Alternate: 33872 (1939.1358, Gookin), trimmed.

title.en: Mitsuke: View of the Tenryu River

entries.why: Henderson impression (1963.669): crisp boats and bright river. Alternates: 25672 (1925.3531), 43090 (1941.971, Gookin). The sheet is inscribed 見附; the app writes 見付 (same reading).
The more colourful of two Buckingham impressions (1925.3533): green grass and warm bark, margins trimmed. Alternate: 25676 (1925.3532), full margins, paler.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3534, Buckingham); the headland across the strait with Fuji small on the right.
Henderson impression (1963.670): warmer sky and deeper sea, full margins. Alternate: 25686 (1925.3535). The sheet is inscribed 荒井; the app writes 新居 (same reading).
The stronger of two Buckingham impressions (1925.3536): orange horizon and green slope. Alternate: 25706 (1925.3537), paler.
Gookin impression (1939.1357): bluer sky over the moor. Alternate: 25710 (1925.3538), muted. AIC romanises the station Futakawa; the app says Futagawa.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3539, Buckingham); the castle scaffolding on the right, the long bridge on the left.
Henderson impression (1963.71): slightly fresher colour. Alternate: 25716 (1925.3540, Buckingham), warmer tints, equally sound.

title.ja: 赤坂 旅舎招婦ノ図

entries.why: Only impression at AIC (1925.3541, Buckingham); the inn courtyard around the sago palm. The sheet is inscribed 赤阪; the app writes 赤坂 (same reading).
Henderson impression (1963.671): stronger evening sky. Alternate: 25725 (1925.3542). AIC reads 棒鼻 bōhana; the app's gate name uses Bōbana.
Henderson impression (1963.672): the bluest mountain and strongest colour of four. Alternates: 25729 (1925.3543), 25732 (1925.3544), 33865 (1939.1356, Gookin, trimmed).
The richer of two Buckingham impressions (1925.3546): pink sky with a blue band, greener pasture. Alternate: 59095 (1925.3545), paler sky.

title.en: Narumi: Famous Tie-dyed Fabrics of Arimatsu

entries.why: Only impression at AIC (1925.3547, Buckingham); the shibori shops with travellers passing.

title.en: Miya: Religious Festival at Atsuta Shrine

entries.why: Only impression at AIC (1925.3548, Buckingham); the horse race of the festival past the torii.

title.en: Kuwana: The Landing of the Shichiri Ferry Crossing

entries.why: The deeper of two Buckingham impressions (1925.3549): darker wave blue around the boats. Alternate: 25751 (1925.3550), lighter.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3551, Buckingham); the man chasing his hat under the bent willow.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3552, Buckingham); the temple among trees under the blue mountain.
Tyson bequest (1964.1057c), the impression the approved concept page uses; grey-green rain well preserved. Alternate: 25761 (1925.3553) is served by AIC as a monochrome scan, not usable for colour.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3554, Buckingham); the procession climbing the snowy slope to the castle gate.

title.en: Seki: Early Departure from the Main Camp

entries.why: Only impression at AIC (1925.3555, Buckingham); the honjin before dawn with the crested curtains.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3556, Buckingham); the brush-discarding peak at left, the teahouse at right. The sheet is inscribed 坂之下 Sakanoshita; the app writes 坂下 Sakashita.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3557, Buckingham); the procession crossing the bridge in spring rain.

title.en: Minakuchi: Dried Gourd Shavings, A Local Specialty

entries.why: The larger and slightly warmer of two Buckingham impressions (1925.3559). Alternate: 25775 (1925.3558), near identical.
Weissman gift (1997.755): the most vivid of three, orange sky and blue foreground water. Alternates: 18270 (1963.673, Henderson), 25780 (1925.3560, Buckingham).
Only impression at AIC (1925.3561, Buckingham); the running kago bearers before the rest house.
Only impression at AIC (1925.3562, Buckingham); the Hashirii teahouse with ox carts passing.

title.en: Kyoto: The Great Bridge at Sanjo

entries.why: Only Hōeidō impression at AIC (1925.3563, Buckingham); the bridge and the Higashiyama hills. The concept page's Kyoto (1930.76, aic 4421) is a c. 1837–42 sheet from a different Tōkaidō series and is not used.
